name: Pokémon Aesthetic Red
summary:
Aesthetic Red is a Fire Red ROM hack that takes a completely different approach to reinventing the Kanto journey. This isn't yet another enhancement hack trying to add as many features as possible…
Instead, Aesthetic Red is all about enhancing the visual and musical experience of Pokémon. All of the graphics have been changed to create a vibrant aesthetic, inspired by the DS and Game Boy. It also has a brand new soundtrack, with each song chosen to give a refreshing and immersive vibe. On top of that, we've also upgraded the gameplay side of things with new QoL and features, an open world, major rebalancing and more.
